name: Pairs: HDFCBANK / ICICIBANK (stat-arb)
description: W6 statistical-arbitrage example: log spread with an OLS hedge ratio over 120 sessions; enter at |z| >= 2, exit at |z| <= 0.5, stop at |z| >= 4. The short leg is not executable in the PAPER cash book, so with allow_single_leg false this strategy records signals but opens no position. Research example only.
